summary: Iteration-5 verified. Backend: 16/16 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py pass — /api/reports now returns a 'loans' array with correct status transitions on pinjam/kembali; /api/reports/export.pdf returns a real PDF (%PDF, application/pdf, attachment filename) for every (type, period) matrix [transaksi|masuk|hilang] x [semua|harian|bulanan], invalid type -> 400, siswa -> 403, unauth -> 401; PATCH /api/books/{id}/status with reporter stores reported_by, without reporter falls back to logged-in user name, restoring flips report to Ditemukan with found_at. Frontend: Reports > Transaksi headers are exactly ANGGOTA/BUKU/TGL PINJAM/TGL KEMBALI/STATUS, summary cards (total/borrowed/returned) visible, period toggles work, download-pdf-button triggers /api/reports/export.pdf -> 200 application/pdf on each of the 3 tabs and 'Laporan PDF berhasil diunduh' toast shows. Lost/Found modal: lost-book-{id}-button opens lost-book-form, filling note+reporter and confirm-status-button turns status to 'Hilang' + toast; found-book-{id}-button opens found-book-form, confirm restores to 'Tersedia'; Laporan hilang row then shows 'Pelapor: Pak Budi UI' and status 'Ditemukan'. Bulk print: bulk-print-button-open opens bulk-print-view with 10 cards (one per member); print-slot measured 323.5 x 204.1 px (85.6x54mm at 96dpi, within tolerance); bulk-class-select filters cards (X IPS 1 -> 1 card); bulk-print-button triggers window.print (stubbed); bulk-close-button removes 'bulk-mode' body class. /siswa: exactly 2 tabs (katalog, rak); catalog-shelf-{id} shows 'Rak R-xx · <name>'; shelf-chip-R-02 filters to 4 R-02 cards; goto-shelf-{id} switches to student-tab-rak and the corresponding shelf-{id} gets 'highlight' class.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py reports/export.pdf scans transactions/incoming/missing collections unbounded (to_list(2000)) — fine for a school app but add pagination/stream if the collections grow large.
render_report_pdf writes to an in-memory BytesIO on every call; for very large reports consider streaming via FileResponse to avoid loading entire PDF into memory.
LostBookModal reporter field defaults to logged-in user's name — good UX but note staff can type anything; server trusts the string (as requested).
BulkCardPrint has no explicit pagination break between pages; the CSS print layout should include page-break rules (verify @media print in Extras.css). Not tested here since window.print was stubbed.
App.js remains a very large monolithic file; iteration-4 comment still valid — consider splitting Books/Members/Reports/Circulation into components/ dir.
seed_data_creation: test_iteration5.py creates TEST_LOST_* books via /api/books and deletes them in finally blocks; the pinjam/kembali test uses the first Tersedia book and returns it. UI test created one 'Pelapor: Pak Budi UI' Hilang report on BK-610CDAA5 and restored it (now shows Ditemukan).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Nav test ids are nav-{overview|books|members|shelves|circulation|reports}-button. Report tabs are report-transactions-tab/report-incoming-tab/report-missing-tab. Period: period-all/period-daily/period-monthly. For PDF testing in Playwright use page.expect_response('/api/reports/export.pdf'). Bulk print opens via bulk-print-button-open; stub window.print before clicking bulk-print-button. The 10 members include several TEST_* leftovers from previous iterations (harmless). On /siswa the goto-shelf button switches to tab 'rak' and adds class 'highlight' to the matching [data-testid=shelf-{id}] element (Shelves.js).
